notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and causing you to gain 2 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.
